limitations: Single relevant source document per query.
Full-text BM25 has an exact-match advantage.
Top-5 reranking has an 85% development Recall@1 upper bound.
59 of 60 development gold pairs exceed the 512-token limit.
No evaluation queries used for model selection.
Pilot results do not establish generalization.
notes: Synthetic query excerpts from source documents; gold is exact source-document identity, not independent human relevance.
Top-5 reranking only; positions after rank 5 retain Hybrid RRF order.
Cross-Encoder input pairs are truncated at 512 tokens.
Evaluation labels were not used to train or tune the model.
Inference time excludes model loading and Hybrid retrieval; CPU timings are not API latency.
The deployed API still uses Dense E5; Hybrid and Cross-Encoder are offline experiments.

retrieval.remaining_candidates: Retain original Hybrid RRF ordering after the reranked Top-5
retrieval.rerank_sort: Descending Cross-Encoder score; tie-break by Hybrid rank and document ID
